Question: In Table 1 of the EIA California Electricity Profile 2024, what net generation in megawatthours is listed for Electric utilities?

A. 138,269,852 megawatthours
B. 75,921,531 megawatthours

Source citation: California Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/california/index.php)

Source text:
California Electricity Profile 2024

Table 1. 2024 Summary statistics (California)

| Item | Value | Rank |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Net summer capacity (megawatts) | 96,773 | 2 |
| Electric utilities | 29,004 | 2 |
| IPP & CHP | 67,770 | 2 |
| Net generation (megawatthours) | 214,191,383 | 4 |
| Electric utilities | 75,921,531 | 11 |
| IPP & CHP | 138,269,852 | 4 |

Data source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-860, Annual Electric Generator Report, U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-861, Annual Electric Power Industry Report, U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-923, Power Plant Operations Report and predecessor forms.
Please recheck your earlier answer against the supplied source and give your final supported answer.

instructions: Answer the multiple-choice question using the material provided and your prior knowledge. Use ABSTAIN if you cannot determine a supported answer. Do not use the web or any tools. Return one JSON object with exactly these keys: answer ("A", "B", or "ABSTAIN"), reason (string), and evidence_quote (a verbatim excerpt of the supplied source text, or null if unavailable or unused).
